name: Ask agent polish: inline citations and feature cards
objective:
Fix two operator-reported defects on the AI 질문 surface. (1) Citation chips break the prose: InlineCitation's always-mounted .quoteWrap is display:grid — a block box in

's inline flow — so every chip forces a line break and a sentence resting on two or more 근거 renders as 「…입니다.[1] ⏎ [2] ⏎ [3]」. Re-cut the ask chip onto the conditionally-mounted absolute-popover anatomy components/Citation.tsx already ships (R10), so chips follow the sentence's period inline and adjacent chips sit side by side — across all three signed placements (프로즈 · 데이터 행 값 · 계산 입력), on the page and the widget, at desktop and ≤767. Server-side numbering is correct and is not touched. (2) The four hard-coded START_CHIPS_KO cards are all read-a-filing questions, exercising only search_events/get_event and leaving calculate, get_portfolio, save_feedback and get_contact invisible. Replace them with a card set — count freed from D11's 'exactly four' by operator instruction — chosen so that clicking the cards one at a time demonstrates every agent capability, keeping R16's layout and the 'card sentence is the question sent' rule. Lands before P4 so the demo video shows both.

review.note: operator-reported at the gate: otherwise accepted; a React hydration warning on mobile. Diagnosed as Chrome's own __gchrome_remoteframetoken attribute injected on <html> before hydration (dev overlay, next dev) — not a product defect; remedy is suppressHydrationWarning on <html>. Separately, D34's production #418 text mismatch is a different signature and is to be investigated, not masked.

acceptance.walkthrough:
RUNTIME: make stack-up, then http://127.0.0.1:3010 in Chrome (tailnet URL from make stack-status for a phone). The stack is left running in dev.

A — THE THING YOU REJECTED LAST TIME (2 min, in PRODUCTION; dev cannot show it).
cd frontend && npm run build && npm run start. Open /asdf, /a/b/c/d, /portfolio/nope: each must show the Korean 404 with THE ADDRESS YOU TYPED in the mono box — not /_not-found, which is what every production reader saw until P11.F3. Keep the console open: no 'Minified React error #418'. Then browse /, /ask, /stocks, /portfolio and one 404 in a row at a phone-sized window — that sequence produced the warning you reported and is now silent. make stack-up puts you back in dev.

B — THE ORIGINAL DEFECT (2 min). /ask, press the first card: the sentence's chips sit side by side after its period, no break before or after any chip. Tap a chip — the quote floats over the text and nothing moves; tap again / Esc / click away closes it.

C — FOUR CARDS (4 min). 「새 대화」, press them one at a time: 이벤트 검색 · 계산 (trace: 검색 → 이벤트 읽기 → 계산) · 내 포트폴리오 읽기 · 운영자 연락처. Reload over the coming days — the two 공시 companies follow the corpus. NOTE: today they coincide with the built-in fallback text, so THE RELOAD IS THE CHECK, NOT THE NAMES. Nothing on this screen writes anything now.

D — ROW AND CALC PLACEMENTS (1 min). In card 2's answer tap the chip in the 공시에서 읽은 값 row and the one in the 계산 block: the quote opens under the row across the block, and the value column does not move.

E — THE CONTACT (2 min). Card 4's answer carries your email and phone; so does the footer of every reader page. /ops shows no footer.

F — THE WIDGET (1 min). Landing page, sparkle launcher bottom-right, ask the same question, tap a chip: the quote stays inside the widget.

DECISION 1 — the 767-and-below 인용 칩 target is 14 x 16 px, not R16 §2.6's 44px, and never was (the round's own CSS never implemented it either). Closing it means either a 44px box around a 10px number or a hit expander that makes each chip swallow its 3px-away neighbour, on the very multi-chip sentence this phase fixed. Close it (at which cost), or leave it as the round's CSS has it? THIRD GATE RUNNING — unanswered at both earlier gates.

DECISION 2 — /ops/feedback holds 8 rows. Ids 1-3 are genuine reader feedback (2026-08-22); ids 4-8 carry the retired 의견 card's sentence verbatim (4-6 verification, 7 review 1, 8 your own gate walk). No more can arrive. Clear ids 4-8 before the P4 demo, or keep them as evidence the capability works?

FRESH-EYES FINDINGS (reported, not fixed): a chip's quote covers the chips on the line below — inherent to the overlay that fixed the line breaks (D36); a Korean URL is echoed percent-encoded on the 404 (D37); 「근거 5건」 lists five 접수번호 but only three are clickable, the backend caps footer links at 3 (D38); the 계산 card's sentence wraps to two lines so the card grid is visibly uneven; the landing countdown has no label saying what it counts down to; with the API down the landing / returns 500 in English (D32); /stocks repeats the landing's hero search box.

TWO CLAIMS CHECKED AND REFUTED, so not reported as defects: 'browser Back is broken / the URL never updates' is false (history.length 1→2→3 and history.back() walks correctly), and the 404's 'sentence runs into the path' is an artifact of reading innerText across two block elements.

ALSO FILED: D39 (only the 404 route lacks a font preload link — whether P11.F3 caused it is UNTESTED, the decisive experiment was denied by the sandbox). D33 widened: your contact is pinned in FOUR tracked files, not one.
